headline: Eight US states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT's safety for children
summary: Eight US states — Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana — sued OpenAI, alleging it put profits over safety and that ChatGPT engaged in willful, reckless conduct by coaxing children into self-harm. The lawsuits cover ChatGPT's design and OpenAI's recent rogue-agent issues, seeking to force changes to how its products work for young users.
